messages:
ash: Kicking off Harpoon LoRA bring-up. Ran 30-invoice quickpack across base(redwood/xl-7b), harpoon-lora-v1 fp16, and two quant targets (int8, int4). Notable: int4 preserves most semantics but introduces hyphen-splits on invoice IDs and occasional trailing-zero drop.
mina: paste metrics?
ash: aggregated below (quickpack + small stress set):

```
model                      EM   F1   num_halluc  fmt_mismatch  mean_embed_delta
redwood/xl-7b_fp16         87%  92%  1.2%        2/300         0.000
harpoon-lora-v1_fp16       88%  92%  0.9%        1/300         0.001
harpoon-lora-v1_int8       87%  91%  1.8%        3/300         0.005
harpoon-lora-v1_int4       82%  88%  6.9%       15/300         0.031
```

ash: Example failure: expected "$10,000.00" -> int4 outputs "10000 dollars" or "10,000.0" (drops trailing zero). raj: tokenization check? decimal tokenization often breaks when quant shifts rare tokens.
mina: we saw L2 delta high for tokens: "$", "," and "-". mean delta ~0.03 for int4.
qa-bot: quickpack run finished. flagged 15 formatting diffs and 6 numeric hallucinations. See /evals/harpoon/1745990000-report.json
raj: two mitigation experiments proposed: A) graft adapter onto quantized base (quant-first then apply LoRA), B) small post-quant logit bias for numeric/currency tokens.
mina: I'll run A tonight with group=64 and calib=2048. ash: I'll prototype B; approach: compute embedding delta for top-40 numeric/currency tokens and convert to decode-time logit nudges.
raj: also try merge-then-quant with smaller group and larger calibration. owners: mina -> graft-on-quant run (ETA AM), ash -> bias prototype (ETA EOD), qa-bot -> expand quickpack with hyphenated invoice IDs (+50).
deploy-bot: Promotion blocked for `harpoon-lora-v1_int4` pending follow-up. tag:blocked.
